product.description: Precision meets elegance with the Amrij Makeup Pencil Brush A6 Hs20Z. This professional-grade brush features a fine, tapered tip designed for detailed eye work—perfect for eyeliner, eyeshadow blending, and intricate makeup application. The ergonomic pencil-style handle ensures comfortable control and steady hand positioning during use. Crafted with high-quality bristles that maintain their shape through repeated use, this brush delivers flawless results every time. Ideal for makeup artists and beauty enthusiasts who demand accuracy and durability in their tools.
